Description: Validate that Form Type is populated as Occurrence when Claims Trigger is set to Occurrence in IPS Admin
Actions:
1. Login to ezdocs application and navigate to received Liability LOB
2. Click on any existing submission
3. Click Next to navigate to information Screen
4. Click Show CIIM to access IPS Admin screen
5. In IPS Admin, under party tab, set liability Claims Trigger to Occurrence
6. Return to information screen
7. Click Sync CIIM to synchronize data
8. Verify the Form Type field on the information screen
Expected Results: Form Type should be selected as Occurrence
